note: Measured by hand at the largest upload (1920x1080 -> 7680x4320, 4 tiles): 18 s on three warm runs and 18 s after /free (the 8 GB of models reload from RAM). The automatic calibration reported 8 s warm / 17 s cold on its 1536x1024 asset because PiD's progress bar counts tiles, so the first tile was billed as model load. Re-calibrating will overwrite these numbers with that underestimate. The vram* fields ARE from the automatic run on 2026-09-22 and are valid — tile-counting only breaks the load/generate time split, not the memory watch.
